messages:
alejandra: pushed a tiny docs PR to clarify structured output guardrails for tool calling. includes: strict JSON Schema example, a permissive example, and a short TS SDK snippet using invokeTool. PR is #4892.

tom: can you add a short note about explicit nulls? our runtime treats null as a mismatch and falls back. a prompt shim + validator tip would help.

alejandra: good call. i'll add a prompt example: 'omit keys instead of returning null' and a short ajv snippet showing useDefaults.

nate: add a deployment callout: prefer single-shot (non-streaming) for strict parsing at high throughput. streaming makes strict validation brittle.

linkbot: linkbot: checked PR diff (9 links). 1 internal link 404: /internal/serve/response-fallbacks -> change to /internal/runtime/response-fallbacks.

alejandra: fixed link and updated metric name to validate.schema_rate (left legacy alias in parens). merging after a quick lint and :thumbsup:.

tom: :thumbsup: 

nate: :thumbsup:
